Know where the work starts.

Build estimates use a CAD $200/hour baseline. I agree on scope, deliverables and an estimate before work starts.

Debugging & technical support

CAD $200/hour

Scope agreed first

Investigate software behaviour, logs and hardware/software faults. Findings determine the next work; a fix is not guaranteed.

Ongoing maintenance

From CAD $2,000/month

By agreement

An agreed scope of updates, monitoring and maintenance. Included tasks, availability and response expectations are defined before support starts.

Starting prices are not fixed quotes. Scope depends on content, integrations, existing code, hardware access and the amount of rebuilding required. Taxes, hosting, paid tools, device parts and third-party fees are not included. Emergency rebuilds, inherited codebases, unusual hardware and regulated data are quoted after review.
